[[Association Sportive Tanda|Tanda]] (11) | longest winless = [[JC d'Abidjan|JCAT]] (12) | longest losses = [[JC d'Abidjan|JCAT]] (5) | matches = 150 | total goals = 275 | prevseason = [[2015–16 Ligue 1 (Ivory Coast)|2015–16]] | nextseason = [[2017–18 Ligue 1 (Ivory Coast)|2017–18]] | updated = 21 May 2017 }} The '''2016–17 [[Ligue 1 (Ivory Coast)|Ligue 1]]''' was the 58th season of top-tier football in [[Ivory Coast|Côte d'Ivoire]]. The season began on 19 November 2016. [[Association Sportive Tanda|AS Tanda]] are the defending champions, having won each of the last two titles. The league comprises 14 teams, the bottom two of which will be relegated to the 2017-18 [[Ligue 2 (Ivory Coast)|Ligue 2]].[https://www.rsssf.org/tablesi/ivo2017.html Ivory Coast 2016/17], RSSSF.com ==Teams== A total of 14 teams will contest the league, including 12 sides from the [[2015–16 Ligue 1 (Ivory Coast)|2015–16 season]] and two promoted from the 2015–16 [[Ligue 2 (Ivory Coast)|Ligue 2]], San-Pédro and WAC. On the other hand, [[CO Korhogo|Korhogo]] and [[Yopougon FC|Yopougon]] were the last two teams of the [[2015–16 Ligue 1 (Ivory Coast)|2015–16 season]] and will play in [[Ligue 2 (Ivory Coast)|Ligue 2]] for the 2016–17 season.
